task: Unchanged 63-action / 17-sound top1 labels on physically written and reopened two-second Perception Test clips
source_selection: First 128 original observer_train sources ordered by SHA256(hepta-joint-natural-observer-20261029:source_id); first 64 must equal the archived v1 source order
fold_assignment: Registered rank modulo five; all events from a source remain together
retained_events: Original retained events, at most eight per original source; no class or difficulty filtering
selection: Maximum source-uniform OOF accuracy, first registered candidate wins ties, then refit on all 128 training sources. Selection and OOF reporting share development data and cannot establish independent confirmation.
normalization: Source-uniform training-fold mean/std; floor 0.01; clamp [-8,8]; validation labels and features never fit normalization or regression
objective: Source-uniform weighted ridge one-hot regression with unpenalized intercept and all original ontology classes
action_features: Pinned S3D pooled 1424 baseline; pinned TSM Something-Something V2 pooled 2222 candidate; eight fixed odd-index frames from the actual sixteen-frame target
sound_features: Pinned PANN MobileNetV2 baseline 1551. Candidate concatenates baseline with three chronological equal-index partitions of the same final convolution time axis, each pooled as max+mean through frozen fc1 and AudioSet head. No annotation timing, source id or label is supplied to feature extraction.
source_independence: Original video ids; participant independence remains unknown
interpretation: A registered development revision after the failed v1 pilot, not a replacement or successful semantic qualification. Higher source count and feature changes are separately visible through same-cohort controls; no claims about independent participant or generated-output accuracy. The 64 fresh calibration sources stay unread even if this development gate passes.
